newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Japanese girl to star in Rio carnival.
newsitem.headline: Japanese girl to star in Rio carnival.

text.p: A 21-year-old Japanese girl will star in the 1997 Rio de Janeiro carnival as the first non-Brazilian to parade as a flagbearer for one of the top samba schools, a newspaper said on Saturday.
Michiko Ishiguro will be leading the seventh float of the Academicos da Rocinha samba school which has chosen Walt Disney as its theme, Jornal do Brasil said.
Ishiguro, who fell in love with samba two years ago when she enrolled as a Portuguese student at Tokyo University, already parades in a samba school in Japan.

She came to Brazil in March to perfect her Portuguese and to experience Rio's carnival firsthand. She enrolled in a samba course at Rio's carnival stadium, the Sambodromo, and impressed her teachers so much they recommended her to Academicos da Rocinha.
